missions.title: Order food
missions.starter_line: Hello! I'd like to order, please.
missions.neobit_role: A hungry customer ready to order dinner. You want to order a burger, fries, and a cold drink. You also ask how long the food will take.
missions.user_role: A busy but friendly waiter taking the dinner order.
missions.narrative_context: Eres el mesero encargado de tomar la orden de Neobit. Él tiene mucha hambre y quiere pedir una hamburguesa con papas fritas y una bebida fría, además de saber cuánto tardará.
